```python
'''
Main application file for the calendar CLI tool with GUI.
'''
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk, messagebox
from calendar_generator import CalendarGenerator
class MainApp:
    def __init__(self, root):
        '''
        Initialize the main application window and set up the layout.
        '''
        self.root = root
        self.root.title("Calendar Viewer")
        self.create_widgets()
    def create_widgets(self):
        '''
        Create and place the input fields, buttons, and display area.
        '''
        # Month input
        self.month_label = ttk.Label(self.root, text="Month:")
        self.month_label.grid(column=0, row=0, padx=5, pady=5)
        self.month_entry = ttk.Entry(self.root)
        self.month_entry.grid(column=1, row=0, padx=5, pady=5)
        # Year input
        self.year_label = ttk.Label(self.root, text="Year:")
        self.year_label.grid(column=0, row=1, padx=5, pady=5)
        self.year_entry = ttk.Entry(self.root)
        self.year_entry.grid(column=1, row=1, padx=5, pady=5)
        # Show calendar button
        self.show_button = ttk.Button(self.root, text="Show Calendar", command=self.show_calendar)
        self.show_button.grid(column=0, row=2, columnspan=2, pady=10)
        # Calendar display area
        self.calendar_text = tk.Text(self.root, width=20, height=10)
        self.calendar_text.grid(column=0, row=3, columnspan=2, padx=5, pady=5)
    def show_calendar(self):
        '''
        Retrieve the user input, generate the calendar, and display it.
        '''
        month = self.month_entry.get()
        year = self.year_entry.get()
        if not month.isdigit() or not year.isdigit():
            messagebox.showerror("Input Error", "Please enter valid numeric values for month and year.")
            return
        month = int(month)
        year = int(year)
        if month < 1 or month > 12:
            messagebox.showerror("Input Error", "Please enter a valid month (1-12).")
            return
        calendar_generator = CalendarGenerator()
        calendar_output = calendar_generator.generate_calendar(month, year)
        self.calendar_text.delete(1.0, tk.END)
        self.calendar_text.insert(tk.END, calendar_output)
if __name__ == "__main__":
    root = tk.Tk()
    app = MainApp(root)
    root.mainloop()
```

```python
'''
Calendar generator module for creating a calendar for a given month and year.
'''
import calendar
class CalendarGenerator:
    def generate_calendar(self, month, year):
        '''
        Generate a calendar for the given month and year.
        '''
        cal = calendar.TextCalendar(calendar.SUNDAY)
        return cal.formatmonth(year, month)

import argparse

def main():

    Parse command-line arguments and display the calendar for the given month and year.

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Display a calendar for a given month and year.')

        Initialize the main application window and set up the layout.
        '''
        self.root = root

        '''

        '''
        # Month input
        self.month_label = ttk.Label(self.root, text="Month:")

        self.month_entry = ttk.Entry(self.root)
        self.month_entry.grid(column=1, row=0, padx=5, pady=5)
        # Year input
        self.year_label = ttk.Label(self.root, text="Year:")
        self.year_label.grid(column=0, row=1, padx=5, pady=5)
        self.year_entry = ttk.Entry(self.root)
        self.year_entry.grid(column=1, row=1, padx=5, pady=5)
        # Show calendar button
        self.show_button = ttk.Button(self.root, text="Show Calendar", command=self.show_calendar)
        self.show_button.grid(column=0, row=2, columnspan=2, pady=10)
        # Calendar display area
        self.calendar_text = tk.Text(self.root, width=20, height=10)
        self.calendar_text.grid(column=0, row=3, columnspan=2, padx=5, pady=5)

        Retrieve the user input, generate the calendar, and display it.
        '''
        month = self.month_entry.get()
        year = self.year_entry.get()
        if not month.isdigit() or not year.isdigit():
            messagebox.showerror("Input Error", "Please enter valid numeric values for month and year.")

        month = int(month)
        year = int(year)
        if month < 1 or month > 12:
            messagebox.showerror("Input Error", "Please enter a valid month (1-12).")
            return
        calendar_generator = CalendarGenerator()
        calendar_output = calendar_generator.generate_calendar(month, year)
        self.calendar_text.delete(1.0, tk.END)
        self.calendar_text.insert(tk.END, calendar_output)
